ttea.dao

Data Access Objects (DAOs) of the T-TEA platform.

Developed by the Larva UDESC team.

This package provides the DAO classes that persist the models in CSV and INI files.

Attributes

__version__str

The current version of the package.

__date__str

The release date of this version.

__author__str

The development team.

__license__str

The license under which the package is distributed.

See Also

DAO

Generic interface for CRUD operations.

CalibrationIniDAO

Calibration data in an INI file.

CalibrationPointCsvDAO

Calibration corner points in a CSV file.

CalibrationSettingIniDAO

Calibration settings in an INI file.

InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO

Institutions/facilities, one CSV file each.

PlayerCsvDAO

Players, one CSV file each.

ProfessionalCsvDAO

Professionals, one CSV file each.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development. Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea

Modules

calibrationinidao

INI persistence of the Calibration record (QSettings).

calibrationpointcsvdao

CSV persistence of the calibration corner points.

calibrationsettinginidao

INI persistence of the CalibrationSetting record (QSettings).

dao

Generic DAO interface for the persistence classes.

institutionfacilitycsvdao

CSV persistence of institutions/facilities, one file each.

playercsvdao

CSV persistence of players, one file per player.

professionalcsvdao

CSV persistence of professionals, one file per professional.
